plan_scope.interpretation_against_actual_plan: The plan explicitly admits scoped supplied reductions and durable scientific inputs, and requires native numerical boundaries rather than independent rederivation of every published IBP. A source-certified exact parent connection transformed by the generic common-mass machinery is a permitted supplied symbolic reduction result for that numerical workflow. Native generic closure and recursive IBPs are actually exercised for boundary subfamilies; the parent supplied connection remains an explicit trust boundary, not an unverified residual silently accepted as a master. Therefore no additional top-level RustRed regeneration is a prerequisite for this scoped notebook gate. Its absence must remain stated and must not be used as evidence of broader automatic-reduction parity.

verified_source_contracts.qualification: Displayed diagrams are effective zero-loop vertices containing the two-loop EW form factors. They are not an enumeration of all underlying two-loop diagrams. Finite-top QCD is excluded.

verified_source_contracts.result: Finite-epsilon canonical projection includes exp(2 gamma_E epsilon) and exact root factors before fitting. Form factors use current s,t,mH squared,mV squared and apply -1/[mV^4(4pi)^4] once. Input boundary identity, crossing coordinates, epsilon range and root germ are checked before contraction.
verified_source_contracts.qualification: The ggHg convenience workflow supports the admitted real physical chamber and its declared root conventions; this gate does not prove all kinematics or arbitrary multiloop configurations.
